author: Good Enough
description:
What looks like a peaceful, crystal clear spring in Texas hides one of the most dangerous underwater cave systems in the United States.

Jacob’s Well is a vertical shaft that drops more than 100 feet into a series of narrow, twisting underwater chambers. The tight passages, sudden turns, and low visibility have trapped many experienced divers over the years.
